    GHOST SKILLS

    Team Claude skills written to cost almost nothing in tokens. Three commands run the whole crew: /load, /save, /cmds. Everything else wakes only when its trigger fires.

    What a node folder is: every skill lives in one top folder of the repo. On the map each folder is one colored branch off the GHOST hub, and each dot on that branch is one skill inside it. You install folder by folder, so this tells you what to install and what you can skip. Tap a skill below to jump to it on the map; tap a color in the map legend to hide or show that whole branch.
